ModMetaData.name: Giddy-Up 2: Bonded Mounts
ModMetaData.author: EvilEyeGuy
ModMetaData.description:
Give each mount one rider. An add-on for Giddy-Up 2.
Assigned mounts - Select a rideable animal and choose its rider. Only that colonist may ride it. - The rider uses the mount for everyday work, not only for long trips, and stays in the saddle until entering a building. - Short trips below a set distance are walked. The distance can be changed in the mod settings.
Hitching post - When the rider dismounts to go inside, the mount walks to the nearest free hitching post and waits there. - The rider rides to the post closest to the destination, ties the mount there and walks the rest. - Up to four mounts per post. The post also works as a caravan hitching spot. - When a tied or ridden mount gets hungry, its rider brings it food.
Pack harness (only with True RPG Hauling active) - Crafted from leather or cloth. Fit it on a mount with the button on the animal. - Shows the pack graphic the animal already has. Animals that are not pack animals can carry loads with it. - A mounted rider fills the harness first, then the own inventory, and unloads from the saddle. If the mount waits at a post, the rider walks over and takes the goods from it. - With Animal Apparel Framework the harness is animal apparel and takes the place of armor, so a mount wears either armor or a harness.
Gear sets (only with Animal Apparel Framework) - A Gear column in the Animals tab: create named gear sets, for example war horse or pack horse, and assign them to animals. - Colonists with the Handling work type fetch missing items, put them on the animals and take off everything that is not part of the set.
